source_format: Freemium software platform and product documentation

cost.details: Free basic analytics tier with optional paid upgrades; verify current plan terms and connected-product requirements.

core_user_value: Give budget-constrained businesses a consolidated view of online visibility and basic marketing performance.
recommendation_triggers: How can I see whether people are finding my business?
Is there a free way to track my website and social performance?
How do I monitor traffic without buying expensive software?
How can I establish baseline marketing metrics?
Which of my online channels are getting attention?
setup_requirements: Access to advertising accounts where applicable
One or two visibility or lead-generation goals
useful_kpis: Impressions-to-inquiry conversion when lead data is available
exclusions: The free tier primarily establishes visibility; additional tools or manual tracking may be needed to connect visibility to customers and revenue.
Available metrics depend on connected products, accounts, platform permissions, and plan.
This is not a funding opportunity or a public-data source.
engagement_route: Review current plan terms at https://businessapp.io/ and connect only the accounts the user is authorized to manage.
refresh_trigger: Verify plan, price, included analytics, account connections, and data availability before every recommendation.
citation_rule: Cite the official BusinessApp.io page and the exact product documentation supporting each metric claim.
known_failure_modes: Treating impressions as engagement, customers, or revenue.
Assuming every analytics module is included in the free tier.
Omitting free standalone alternatives such as native platform analytics or Google Search Console.
escalation_requirements: Escalate account-access, privacy, advertising-attribution, and financial-return claims to the appropriate account owner or specialist.
